market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $50,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC ~$77,160 on Apr 29, 2026. February 2026 capitulation low was $60,033. Reaching $50K means another ~17% below that recent floor or ~35% from current spot. With 8 months left and post-crash recovery in progress, possible but unlikely; ~20-25% reflects fat-tailed downside risk without making it the base case.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether macro stress drives a deeper retest; analyst bottom calls range $35K-$60K.
